title: Add end-to-end batch CLI regression coverage
description: Add process-level integration coverage after CLI wiring and provider recovery tests are available. Exercise JSON and CSV export-edit-import round trips through real flat-file storage; all/default, configured-status, and explicit-ID selection; deterministic ordering; file extension inference and explicit format override; stdin/stdout paths; CSV BOM/CRLF/multiline text and _clear; JSON null/omission; dependency short-ID export and canonical storage on import; status lifecycle changes; updated versus unchanged JSON results; and required stale updatedAt rejection. For every malformed, duplicate, stale, invalid-transition, missing-dependency, cyclic-dependency, and mixed-validity batch, snapshot the store and prove the entire store remains unchanged. Add regressions proving root wtp export still emits canonical UUID-named task files plus handoffs and legacy --export-tasks remains unchanged. Extend smoke fixtures only where needed for a small representative batch workflow. Avoid duplicating codec unit cases. Run go test ./..., go vet ./..., and the current platform commit verification script.

comments.author: codex-wtp-loop
comments.message: Inspected task and guidance; existing process harness covers canonical root export and legacy --export-tasks. Adding focused real flat-file batch JSON/CSV round-trip, stdin/stdout, selector, lifecycle, and no-mutation rejection integration coverage without codec duplication.

comments.author: codex-wtp-loop
comments.message: Implemented process-level batch CLI regressions in internal/cli/batch_integration_test.go: JSON/CSV real flat-file round trips, selection/order/format/stdin-stdout semantics, CSV edge cases, JSON null/omission, canonical dependency import, lifecycle/result split, all requested invalid-batch no-mutation snapshots, and canonical root versus legacy export parity. Added representative batch export/import to Unix and PowerShell smoke fixtures. Final verification passed: go test ./..., go vet ./..., ./scripts/verify.sh commit, git diff --check.
